The knoll of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The juniper is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jetty.
